value: Sensitivity not known: VNtyper measured no depth over the VNTR.
VNtyper calls no frameshift, but its coverage check is NOT_EVALUATED (no measured depth over the VNTR, 50x is its floor on GRCh38), so a frameshift cannot be ruled out.

A negative here lowers the chance of the frameshifts VNtyper looks for; it does not rule ADTKD-MUC1 out. A family history of kidney failure with gout or a bland urine sediment still deserves a clinical test (SNaPshot for dupC).
